fields.contract: Configures an Orleans client builder for ArgentSea clustering. UseArgentSeaClustering(this IClientBuilder builder, Action<IConfiguration> configuration) applies a non-null Action<IConfiguration> to service configuration (skipping a null action) and registers both clustering membership/configuration validation services (IMembershipTable -> ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable and IConfigurationValidator -> ClusterOptionsValidator / IConfigureOptions<ClusterClientDbOptions> -> ArgentSeaClusteringGatewayOptionsValidator) AND singleton IGatewayListProvider -> ArgentSeaGatewayListProvider; AddArgentSeaClustering(this IClientBuilder, Action<OptionsBuilder<ClusterClientDbOptions>>) likewise registers both IConfigureOptions<ClusterClientDbOptions> -> ArgentSeaClusteringGatewayOptionsValidator and IGatewayListProvider -> ArgentSeaGatewayListProvider. The method returns the configured IClientBuilder.
fields.name: ClusteringExtensions.UseArgentSeaClustering (IClientBuilder)
